stop.prompt: Session is ending. If you made non-trivial changes, ran multi-step workflows, or hit a surprise worth remembering, append ONE entry to docs/knowledge/MEMORY.md using the template at the top of that file. If the session was trivial (a single small fix, pure conversation, or read-only exploration), respond with exactly 'no memory entry needed' and do nothing else. Do not edit MEMORY.md more than once.
